name: warm-tight-drum-bus
description: USER-PREFERRED drum bus: WARM with a TIGHT, controlled bottom end. Approved 2026-06-01 on the artifacts/drums multi-mic kit (full 10.5 min). The warmth comes from a tilt EQ + Studer A800 tape (NOT brightness/EQ boosts); the tight bottom from an HPF + low-band multiband control + 30 IPS tape (head-bump up ~100 Hz, no sub bloom). Reproduce the whole pipeline below.
pipeline: 1. SOURCE: phase-aligned multi-mic stems (drum-prep phase-align on the raw kit -> <kit>/phase-aligned/). 7 mics: overhead(st), drum room(st), kick in, kick beater, snare top, snare bottom, hi hat.

2. PER-STEM PROCESS: scripts/mix/process_stems.py with presets/mix/drums-stem-process.plans.json (declick OFF; role-aware clean/de-box/de-harsh/transient + conservative API Vision Channel Strip color, 550 tops kept flat) -> <kit>/processed/.
3. WARM BALANCE: scripts/mix/balance_stems.py with the per-role targets below (measured LUFS; bright stems DOWN, body/room UP) -> bus_warm_pre.wav.
4. WARM+TIGHT CHAIN: scripts/mix/warm_bus.py bus_warm_pre.wav bus_warm.wav (the exact tone chain; params encoded in that script).

balance_targets_lufs._method: measured integrated LUFS per stem, gained to target; one global -6 dBFS-peak headroom trim on the sum (NOT peak-normalized per stem)
balance_targets_lufs._note: snare-bottom/hat/beater pulled DOWN (they carry the brightness), room/body UP for warmth

bus_chain._impl: scripts/mix/warm_bus.py — authoritative; values mirrored here for reference

2_multiband_low_control._intent: compress the LOW band so the bottom is tight/even

3_studer_a800_tape._intent: warmth + glue; 30 IPS keeps lows tight (no sub-bloom head bump)

approved_signature_full_kit._note: centroid is content-dependent; the 60s opening measured ~3990 (brighter passage). If a brighter source over-darkens, ease high_shelf -4 -> -2 @6k and repro_hf_eq 2 -> 3.

notes: Warmth is tape + tilt, never a bright EQ boost. Tight bottom = HPF + low multiband + 30 IPS (NOT 15 IPS, whose bigger ~60 Hz head bump blooms the low end). This is a MIX bus (peak -1, not mastered) — hand to master-track for loudness.
